# Programming Tools & Frameworks

A collection of useful tools and frameworks for modern software development.

## Python
- **FastAPI** - Modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python. https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/
- **Pydantic** - Data validation using Python type annotations. https://docs.pydantic.dev/
- **Poetry** - Python dependency management and packaging. https://python-poetry.org/

## JavaScript / TypeScript
- **React** - A JavaScript library for building user interfaces. https://react.dev/
- **Next.js** - The React framework for production. https://nextjs.org/
- **TypeScript** - Typed superset of JavaScript. https://www.typescriptlang.org/

## DevOps & Tools
- **Docker** - Container platform for developing, shipping, and running applications. https://www.docker.com/
- **GitHub Actions** - CI/CD platform integrated with GitHub.
- **Terraform** - Infrastructure as Code tool.
- **Kubernetes** - Container orchestration platform. https://kubernetes.io/
